items.name: OYA-OQS
items.title: Liouvillian Lieb-Schultz-Mattis Constraints in Open Quantum Systems
items.description: Local, translationally invariant Lindbladians with strong U(1) symmetry and a unique steady state in a fixed-charge sector exhibit asymptotically gapless modes in the thermodynamic limit: long-wavelength modes at any filling, plus additional modes at wave vectors set by non-integer filling.

items.name: ssb-qme
items.title: Symmetry-Enforced Strong Quantum Mpemba Effect
items.description: Developing a symmetry-based mechanism for strong quantum Mpemba effects in symmetry-broken open systems. Current work studies discrete parity and continuous U(1) symmetries through Liouvillian analysis and quantum-master-equation simulations.
